record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: Fix a number field K, an integer B≥1, and degree d≥2. As f ranges over generalized Hénon maps of degree d over K, is the number of periodic points P with [K(P):K]≤B uniformly bounded in terms of [K:Q], d, and B?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2. — Let K be a number field, let B ≥ 1, and let d ≥ 2. Then as f varies over generalized Hénon maps of degree d over K, the quantity #{P ∈ Per(f) : [K(P) : K] ≤ B} is bounded just in terms of [K : Q], d, and B.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a number field, let $B\geq 1$ be an integer, and let $d\geq 2$ be an integer. A generalized Hénon map of degree $d$ over $K$ is a polynomial automorphism $f:\mathbb{A}^2\to\mathbb{A}^2$ defined over $K$ that is conjugate (over $\overline{K}$) to a finite composition $f_1\circ f_2\circ\cdots\circ f_m$ of maps of the form $f_i(x,y)=(y,\,p_i(y)-a_i x)$, where each $p_i\in K[y]$ is a polynomial of degree at least $2$, each $a_i\in K^\times$, and the total degree $\prod_i\deg(p_i)$ equals $d$. For such a map $f$, let
$$\operatorname{Per}(f)=\{P\in\mathbb{A}^2(\overline{K}) : f^n(P)=P\text{ for some }n\geq 1\}$$
denote its set of periodic points, and for $P\in\operatorname{Per}(f)$ let $K(P)$ be the field of definition of $P$ over $K$.

Question: Does there exist a constant $C=C([K:\mathbb{Q}],d,B)$, depending only on $[K:\mathbb{Q}]$, $d$, and $B$, such that
$$\#\{P\in\operatorname{Per}(f) : [K(P):K]\leq B\}\;\leq\;C$$
for every generalized Hénon map $f$ of degree $d$ defined over $K$?
artifact.status_search_result: This is stated as a conjecture, posed as a two-dimensional analogue of the Morton–Silverman uniform boundedness conjecture in arithmetic dynamics, which itself remains open. Recent work has only established such uniform bounds for restricted classes (e.g., polynomial maps with good reduction), and no resolution for generalized Hénon maps is reported. The problem appears to be open.

status_evidence.title: AIM Workshop: The uniform boundedness conjecture in arithmetic dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: The Morton–Silverman uniform boundedness conjecture for preperiodic points remains a central open problem in arithmetic dynamics.
status_evidence.claim: The underlying Morton–Silverman style uniform boundedness conjecture is open.

status_evidence.title: Uniform bounds on periodic points of polynomials with good reduction
status_evidence.snippet: Effective bounds are established only under a mild reduction hypothesis for polynomial maps, not for generalized Hénon maps in general.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial progress exists in restricted settings; the general Hénon case is unresolved.
